results.note: The notes list's "+ New" arrow ("More ways to start a note"), Voice note. On a phone the "+ New" group is not drawn; the More menu's phone-only Voice note row is the door there (go-live wave 1, C1).

results.feature: Ask the Notebook: the AI button on the notes list
results.note: Research home's Ask moved behind the notes list's "AI" button (simplify Task 5); at 1024 px and below the button gives way to the More menu's "Ask your Notebook" row (go-live wave 1, D2).

results.feature: Ask the Notebook: the labelled Ask your Notebook section
results.note: The section opens under the list's toolbar from the AI button. At 390 the More menu's Ask your Notebook opens the same section, and its question opens as a bottom sheet over the list (AskPanel, autoOpen), so the door measured there is the sheet's own Ask button.

results.feature: Browser capture extension: Import, Capture from anywhere
results.note: Go-live wave 2 (Notebook simplify): a bare /journal/notebook opens the notes list, so the old 'View all notes' press from Research home is gone. Import is a row of the "+ New" arrow's menu (simplify Task 3); on a phone, of the More menu.

results.feature: Journal styles manager (P1): More, Manage templates
results.note: The styles manager is the list's More menu row "Manage templates" (S7, one vocabulary: the toolbar's Styles button folded into the More menu). Go-live wave 2 (Notebook simplify): a bare /journal/notebook opens the notes list, so the old 'View all notes' press from Research home is gone.

results.feature: New note from a template, the phone's More menu
results.note: Go-live wave 2: this row walked Research home's View all notes to reach the list's caret; the list is the landing now, so at 1280 it is row 55's door exactly. It now records the phone's door to the same choice, the More menu's phone-only row.

reason.text: Go-live wave 2, by ruling: on a phone the list's "+ New" group is not drawn (S12) and Research home's New note caret was retired with it (simplify Task 5), so the phone's door is the More menu's New from a template; the template sheet it opens keeps the note kinds above its search, and the measured Daily prep button sat outside the sheet's first screen (3 presses, one scroll). 1280: OK (3 presses). Recorded in the ledger, Go-live wave 2. Final fix (A1): the phone row now carries a literal walkthrough anchor (data-tour="new-from-template-phone") and the Template gallery and Template library walkthroughs start on it at 390 (More notebook actions, then New from a template), so a phone member is walked to this door; the presses and the scroll to Daily prep are unchanged. Owner call: accept, or open the kind picker from the phone row.

results.note: The P1 kind picker's Daily prep button (KindSection.jsx, aria-label "New " + the kind's name); the note it makes holds the prep pack (Daily prep v2). Reached the way row 55 reaches the menu. The button exists only after the lazy KindSection chunk and GET /api/j2/journal-styles answer, so the target wait is 15 s (as row 53's). Three counted presses, so OK is its best verdict. Rows 61 (Before / after this rule) and 62 (Mark a rule before entry) have no entry here: the audit's members cannot reach either (the card needs an account, a tagged trade and a rule; the switch lives inside a note's My rules block), so the walk measures them (blocks.before-after, blocks.my-rules): walk-measured, presence and content, not graded for clicks or fold. Tier 2 part A's screenshot tag offer ("Tag NVDA · Daily", the toolbar "Screenshot tag") has no entry here for the same reason: it appears only after a chart screenshot is pasted and read by OCR, which an audit row cannot do, and as the file's only unmeasurable_here row it would hold the audit at exit 3 forever (ruling R-T13-1, b171f98dad). The walk measures it (smart.screenshot-tag, at 1280, 820 and 390): walk-measured, not graded for clicks or fold.
